design.summary: Wild fur-clad raider in brown leather and bone with a horned helm and two heavy axes.
design.silhouette: Wide bone-horned helm, huge fur collar making the shoulders enormous, one axe in each fist hanging low; very stocky.

headgear.description: Open-faced rough iron-brown helm with two thick cream bone horns curving forward, wild hair spilling out the sides.

armour.description: Huge brown fur mantle over both shoulders with bone studs.
Bare tanned chest crossed by a brown leather harness with bone buckles.
Thick studded belt hung with small bone trophies.
Fur-topped brown boots with leather wraps.

design.cloth: Short ragged brown kilt-skirt of leather strips; a tattered fur cloak hangs down the back.
design.weapon_summary: Two heavy single-bladed hand axes with brown handles and dull steel blades, one in each hand, blades pointing outward and down when idle.

proportions.style: short wide chibi: big head (about 1/3 of the height), stocky wide torso, short thick limbs, big hands and boots
proportions.notes: Standing height is equal in the down, up and right views. Feet of every frame rest on ONE baseline row.

weapon.name: double axes
weapon.description: Two heavy single-bladed hand axes with brown handles and dull steel blades, one in each hand, blades pointing outward and down when idle.

down.descriptor: FRONT view (down): the figure faces the camera, face and chest visible, both boots visible, toes toward the viewer.

up.descriptor: BACK view (up): the figure faces away from the camera. NO face, NO eyes, NO mouth anywhere: show only the back of the head/headgear, the back of the torso, back armour and the cape/cloth hanging down the back, and the heels of both boots. Back view: bone horns from behind, wild hair, the ragged fur cloak covering the back, axe handles crossed over the lower back.

right.descriptor: RIGHT side view (right): a TRUE side profile facing the right edge of the image, body turned exactly 90 degrees, one eye only, nose/brow in profile; the NEAR arm and NEAR leg are drawn IN FRONT of the torso, the far limbs partly hidden behind it.

poses: Stand relaxed, feet shoulder-width apart, an axe hanging in each fist, chest rests low.
Breathe in: torso rises one pixel step, shoulders lift slightly, the fur cloak and kilt strips.
Peak of the breath: head and chest at their highest, arms swing a hair outward, the fur cloak and kilt strips sways a little.
Breathe out: torso sinks back lower than frame 1, weight shifts slightly, the fur cloak and kilt strips settles.
Contact: left boot planted forward, right boot behind on its toes, arms opposite to legs, an axe hanging in each fist.
Down: body at its lowest, left boot flat under the body, right boot lifting off, right knee bent.
Passing: right leg swings through beside the planted left leg, body at its highest, the fur cloak and kilt strips.
Contact: right boot planted forward, left boot behind on its toes, arms swapped, an axe hanging in each fist.
Down: body at its lowest, right boot flat under the body, left boot lifting off, left knee bent.
Passing: left leg swings through beside the planted right leg, body at its highest, the fur cloak and kilt strips flares.
Wind-up: both axes pulled back and raised behind the shoulders, chest thrust out, roaring mouth open.
Right axe chops down and across in front of the chest, body twisting, left axe still raised.
Left axe chops across the opposite way, both axes crossed in front, front foot stamped forward.
Spin: body twisting full around, both axes extended outward at the sides, far from the body.
Recover: axes dropping back to the hanging pose, shoulders heaving, fur settling.
Gather: both axes raised overhead and clashed together, head thrown back in a roar.
Axes held high and apart, chest out, arms trembling, knees bent.
Axes slammed together in front of the chest, body hunched forward.
Throw: right arm snaps forward releasing the axe pose, arm at full reach ahead, left axe pulled back.
Recover: arm lowering, axes back in both hands, breath heaving.
Crouch low, knees bent deeply, head ducked forward, an axe hanging in each fist pulled in tight.
Launch: body tipping forward, head tucked, back arching, both boots still visible leaving the floor.
Tumble 1: figure curled into a compact ball, head near the knees, back toward the camera side, boots tucked.
Tumble 2: the ball has rotated half a turn, upside down, boots up top, head tucked below.
Tumble 3: rotating up out of the ball, legs reaching down toward the ground, head coming up.
Landing: one knee bent, other boot planted, rising out of the roll, an axe hanging in each fist back in hand.
Struck: head snaps back, torso leans away from the blow, eyes squeezed shut, arms flung outward, an axe hanging in each fist.
Recoil: body bent at the waist, knees buckled, one boot sliding back, wincing, an axe hanging in each fist.
Fatal hit: head snaps back, torso arching, an axe hanging in each fist loosening in the grip.
Stumble: knees give way, one knee drops, a hand drops the weapon, head hangs.
Fall: body topples sideways, both arms flailing, boots leaving the ground.
Impact: the body lands on its side, weapon clattering beside it, cloth settling.
Slump: the body flat on the ground, one arm stretched out, legs straight, head turned.
Final: lying completely still on the ground, weapon at rest next to the hand, cloth lying flat. Feet on the baseline row.
